detail.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Re-verifies the GLM-5 and GLM-5.2 GB200 card items whose `bridge_commit` pins are not in the public repository by re-running the unchanged card commands at public main, and adds a check that verified GB200 training items pin a reachable revision.

# Changelog

- `examples/model_verification_cards/glm5/card.yaml`, `glm5-2/card.yaml`: `sft`, `peft` and `sft_export_inference` (GB200) re-verified on the card base container `nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo:26.08.rc3` at `e2f2496cb`; new `bridge_commit`, `last_verified`, measured metrics, and an `expected_result` stating only what the run measured.
- `docs/_static/model-verification/catalog-v1.json`, `docs/models/glm/glm5*.md`, `docs/fern/.../glm5*.mdx`: regenerated.
- `tests/unit_tests/doc_consistency/test_verification_card_recipe_revisions.py`: `test_glm5_verified_items_pin_reachable_revisions`; items not yet re-verified are listed in `GLM5_PENDING`.

| Card / item (GB200) | Old pin | Result at `e2f2496cb` |
|---|---|---|
| glm5 sft | 49c103c714 | PASS, 100/100, 0 NaN/skip |
| glm5 peft | a860b62ff2 | PASS, 100/100, 0 NaN/skip |
| glm5 sft_export_inference | 49c103c714 | PASS: export (59870 tensors, 791 MTP), 16 strict reloads, 16 tokens |
| glm5-2 sft | 49c103c714 | PASS, 100/100, 0 NaN/skip |
| glm5-2 peft | 0b59ee513f | PASS, 100/100, 0 NaN/skip |
| glm5-2 sft_export_inference | 49c103c714 | PASS: export (59585 tensors, 791 MTP), 16 strict reloads, 16 tokens |

Metrics are steps 91-100 averages; tokens/s/GPU = sequence length × GBS / mean step time / GPUs.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [x] Did you add or update any necessary documentation?
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

If you haven't finished some of the above items you can still open "Draft" PR.

# Additional Information

- Still pinned to commits outside the public repository (excluded via `GLM5_PENDING`):
  - glm5 `pretrain` (`0b59ee513f`): passes at public main, but the validator requires the same commit as `checkpoint_resume`.
  - glm5 `checkpoint_resume` (`0b59ee513f`): **fails at public main** (device OOM in the first resumed step's reduce-scatter); the card still records it as verified.
  - glm5 / glm5-2 `sft_long_context` (`49c103c714`): the 128K dataset has no published generator.
  - glm5-2 `pretrain` / `checkpoint_resume` (`d592bef3fd`): need an MTP-keeping Megatron import that no published command produces.
- The card-level `verification_environment.bridge_commit` (`fc668edc8`) and glm5-2 `manual_forward_pass` (`6887e0393b`) are fetchable but not on main; the test checks only training-item pins.
- Test fails on main's cards and passes on this branch; it needs full git history, so a shallow CI checkout skips it.
- **Reviewer:** @cuichenx
- **NVBug:** 6938912.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("card_path", GLM5_CARDS, ids=lambda path: path.parent.name)
+def test_glm5_verified_items_pin_reachable_revisions(card_path: Path) -> None:
+    if shutil.which("git") is None:
+        pytest.skip("git is not available")
+    card = yaml.safe_load(card_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+    ]

+        pytest.skip("a recorded bridge_commit is not in this shallow checkout's git history")
+    assert not missing, "verified items pin a bridge_commit missing from the repository: " + "; ".join(missing)
